meta.title: Catch And Tame mutations data
meta.notes: The standalone Catch and Tame wiki lists 17 current mutation rows. Fandom also lists older or extra rows such as Bloodmoon, Abducted, Taco, and Crystal; those are not included until they are cross-checked against a current 17-row source.

items.name: Shiny
items.acquisition: Spawns randomly on the map as a wild animal variant.
items.effect: The highest listed income multiplier in the current 17-row source.
items.bestUse: Save high-BPS pets with this mutation because the multiplier is stronger than every other listed mutation.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom cross-check

items.name: Neon
items.acquisition: Spawns randomly on the map as a wild animal variant.
items.bestUse: Keep on valuable income pets; it is the second-highest listed wild multiplier.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom cross-check

items.name: Glass
items.acquisition: Spawns randomly on the map as a wild animal variant.
items.bestUse: Worth keeping on rare or high-BPS pets even when you are still chasing Shiny or Neon.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom cross-check

items.name: Rainbow
items.acquisition: Spawns randomly on the map as a wild animal variant.
items.effect: Wild-spawn income multiplier equal to Bloodbound in the current source.
items.bestUse: Useful on any pet you plan to keep in the pen for steady income.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom cross-check

items.name: Gold
items.acquisition: Spawns randomly on the map as a wild animal variant.
items.bestUse: A practical keeper mutation while farming for rarer 2.5x-plus results.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom cross-check

items.name: Albino
items.acquisition: Spawns randomly on the map as a wild animal variant.
items.bestUse: Good early value, but replaceable once Gold, Rainbow, Glass, Neon, or Shiny appears.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom cross-check

items.name: Bloodbound
items.acquisition: Collect Bloodmoon Grapes during Bloodmoon Weather and feed them to any pet.
items.bestUse: Use Bloodmoon Grapes on pets with strong base BPS instead of low-value filler pets.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom uses Bloodmoon as a related/alternate row name
items.imageStatus: missing clean row image - Fandom mutation table points to broken Bloodmoon icon/effect files; downloadable Bloodmoon Grapes and Weather Event assets rejected as non-row substitutes

items.name: Cosmic
items.acquisition: Applies randomly to pen pets during Cosmic Shower Weather.
items.bestUse: Trigger or join Cosmic Shower when your pen has pets worth upgrading.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom cross-check

items.name: Frozen
items.acquisition: Applies randomly to pen pets during Blizzard or Snowy Weather.
items.bestUse: Best watched during snow-related weather windows, especially if you are also farming weather spawns.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom cross-check

items.name: Fractured
items.acquisition: Applies randomly to pen pets during Gravebound Weather.
items.bestUse: Useful when Gravebound is active, especially alongside Skeletal Mutation Machine progress.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom cross-check
items.imageStatus: missing clean row image - Fandom table lists Fractured file links, but API/allimages checks found no downloadable Fractured asset

items.name: Charged
items.acquisition: Applies randomly to pen pets during Thunderstorm Weather.
items.bestUse: A smaller bonus, but Thunderstorm can also matter for Lightning Dragon spawning.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom and BloxInformer weather cross-check

items.name: Admin
items.acquisition: Applies randomly to pen pets during rare developer-triggered Admin Cloud Weather.
items.bestUse: Treat as opportunistic; do not plan a normal farming route around it.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom cross-check
items.imageStatus: cropped text-free Fandom mutation icon fallback; no clean paired effect image exposed

items.name: Seabound
items.acquisition: Applies randomly to pen pets during Underwater or Tsunami Weather.
items.effect: Small income multiplier; Fandom also lists breed luck increase.
items.bestUse: More useful when the weather also supports ocean pet spawns or breeding plans.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom adds breed luck note

items.name: Volcanic
items.acquisition: Applies randomly to pen pets during Volcanic Eruption Weather.
items.effect: Small income multiplier; Fandom also notes legendary lucky block behavior.
items.bestUse: Best treated as a weather bonus while farming lava-themed spawns or Volcanic Eruption rewards.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom adds lucky block note

items.name: Lovestruck
items.acquisition: Collect Chocolate Hearts during Valentine's Weather and feed them to pets.
items.bestUse: Use on pets you expect to keep, because the event source is narrower than normal wild spawns.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom cross-check

items.name: Cupid
items.acquisition: Combine 5 of the same pet during Valentine's Weather to receive one Cupid version.
items.bestUse: Useful for event collection progress, but lower income value than Lovestruck.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom cross-check

items.name: Skeletal
items.acquisition: Place any pet into the Mutation Machine during Gravebound Weather.
items.bestUse: Use for Skeleton-event collection routes rather than raw income, since the multiplier is small.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom cross-check
